# nso_netconf (Data Source)

This data source can read the configuration of an NSO object via NETCONF, addressed by an XPath.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nso_netconf" "example" {
  path = "/tailf-ncs:ssh"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) An absolute XPath, e.g. `/tailf-ncs:devices/device[name='c1']`.

### Optional

- `instance` (String) An instance name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Map of String) Map of key-value pairs which represents the YANG leafs directly below the object and their values.
- `id` (String) The XPath of the retrieved object.
